grade_reason: She speaks about AI regularly as the top Democrat on the House Science Committee, including a 14 January 2026 hearing statement on the AI Action Plan, but nothing found since 2025 acknowledges catastrophic risk from AI.
notes: All seven searches ran this time (the earlier attempt had zero searches because they were refused). Since 1 January 2025 I found two AI hearing statements of hers. (1) 14 January 2026 opening statement, hearing on the AI Action Plan (https://democrats-science.house.gov/news/press-releases/ranking-member-stevens-opening-statement-for-hearing-on-ai-action-plan): opened; it has no sentence about AI risk, safety, national security, China or catastrophic harm (it is about NIST budget cuts and Michigan manufacturing), so no quote was included. (2) 8 April 2025 opening statement, DeepSeek hearing (https://democrats-science.house.gov/download/4825-rm-stevens-os_deepseek&download=1): could not open (HTTP 410); a search snippet only says it mentions bills to authorize evaluation work, including the AI Safety Institute at NIST. That would be D at most; not included. Her other AI material (2023 hearing on managing AI risks, which talks only about risk management standards and says nothing catastrophic; 2024 hearing on AI for science; December 2024 op-ed on AI and national security; 2024 Small Business AI Advancement Act; 2024 letter with Obernolte asking for $10 million for the AI Safety Institute) all predates 2025 and is outside the time window. A Transformer News piece on the 2026 Michigan Senate race says she 'hasn't been as critical of the industry' as Mallory McMorrow; that is a characterization, not her words. A 14 September 2026 ClickOnDetroit article on AI risk in the Michigan Senate race does not mention her (it names El-Sayed and Rogers as the candidates). Ban Artificial Superintelligence Act (H.R. 10538, introduced 24 September 2026 by Casar): no source shows her as a cosponsor, but no complete cosponsor list was available (partial lists name Hoyle, Lynch, Tonko, Ansari, Ocasio-Cortez), so this is not confirmed either way. The many-signer House letters were not searched, per instructions. Her press releases from 2025 to mid-2026 were not individually checked beyond what the searches surfaced.
